title: Base Power photo banner
description: A full-bleed photo band darkened from the left: a small light tag, a big white heading with a lime hand-drawn underline, an optional sentence, and a lime button beside a light hairline one (stacked full width on phones). Content-sized, generous padding. Works as a mid-page pitch or a closing call to action.
notes: carries the dark class itself (light ink over the photo)
leave out body for the shorter closing band
